relations.quote: This convolution computes its transforms by [Synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md), which need only signed shifts, address rearrangements and butterflies.

This convolution computes its products through [Signed coefficient packing (Kronecker substitution)](signed-packing.md): polynomial products are packed into integers and multiplied by the ordinary $O(n\log n)$ multiplier as a subroutine.
This convolution is applied after [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), which writes each source transform through a power-of-two tensor transform.

symbols.name: input array phi
symbols.meaning: The first of the two input arrays being convolved.
symbols.quote: Let $\phi$ and $\psi$ be the two input arrays.

symbols.name: input array psi
symbols.meaning: The second of the two input arrays being convolved.
symbols.quote: Let $\phi$ and $\psi$ be the two input arrays.

symbols.name: cyclic convolution
symbols.meaning: The cyclic convolution of two arrays on one axis of length t, with products taken in the ring.
symbols.quote: Let $\ast$ denote their cyclic convolution on one axis of length $t$, with products taken in the ring:

symbols.name: forward transform
symbols.meaning: The forward transform, which sends an array to its list of frequency entries indexed by m.
symbols.quote: The forward transform $\mathcal D$ sends an array to $(\mathcal D\phi)_m=\sum_i\omega^{mi}\phi_i$, where $\omega$ is the primitive $t$th root of unity of the ring and $m$ is the frequency index.

symbols.name: opposite transform
symbols.meaning: The opposite transform, which inverts the forward transform up to the normalization factor.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal D^{+}$ be the opposite transform.

symbols.name: normalization scalar
symbols.meaning: The known scalar fixed by the normalization of the transforms.
symbols.quote: Let $M$ be the known scalar fixed by the normalization of the transforms.

symbols.name: entrywise product
symbols.meaning: The product of ring elements at the same address, applied entry by entry.
symbols.quote: Let $\odot$ be the entrywise product of ring elements at the same address.

symbols.name: layout permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation of addresses fixed by the layout of the forward transforms, which stores the entry for frequency m at address chi(m).
symbols.quote: Let $\chi$ be the permutation of addresses that the layout of the forward transforms fixes: the entry for frequency $m$ is stored at address $\chi(m)$, so the stored arrays are $\chi\mathcal{D}\phi$ and $\chi\mathcal{D}\psi$.
